# Xavi Almirall

> Product Designer with a background in psychology, designing software that fits how people actually think and behave.

Personal portfolio of Xavi Almirall, a Barcelona-based Product Designer. Former Tech Recruiter turned UX/UI Designer, combining a psychology background with user research and interface design. The site presents three UX case studies and a background/skills page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://xavialmirall.com/): Introduction and the three featured case studies below.
- [About](https://xavialmirall.com/about): Background, career timeline (Psychology degree → Tech Recruiter → UX/UI bootcamp → Product Designer), and a skills breakdown (research & strategy, design, tools).
- [Veond](https://xavialmirall.com/veond): Case study — redesign of the restaurant checkout flow and UI for Veond, a vegan deals marketplace app. UX research, UI design, mobile.
- [EatsyPeasy](https://xavialmirall.com/eatsypeasy): Case study — native iOS wellness app built from user research, helping people track mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.
- [Spotify Local Scene](https://xavialmirall.com/localscene): Case study — a concept feature for Spotify that helps users discover emerging local artists based on location.
